title: Decision brief
heading: Decide the release plan in one pass
subhead: Why this form: three choices block the release, and each one changes what you will be asked to review next week. About 3 minutes. Each question says why it matters, what is at stake, and what I recommend, with how sure I am.

questions.why: This sets how often the release waits for you, so it decides how much of your week the release takes.
questions.label: When should a change go live without your yes?
questions.hint: Covers code changes only; docs always go live.
questions.stakes: Waiting for a yes cost about 30 minutes per change last month. Going ahead on green tests saves that, but a wrong change stays live until you read the summary.

recommendation.because: Every defect last month was caught by tests, and none by a yes.
recommendation.risk: A change that passes its tests and is still wrong stays live until the summary.

questions.why: These are the moments you will be interrupted; everything else waits for the weekly summary.
questions.label: Which events should interrupt you?

recommendation.because: Both need a judgment only you can make; the rest can wait a week.

questions.why: The cadence decides when you next hear from me without asking.
questions.label: How often should summaries arrive?
questions.stakes: Daily means five short reads a week; weekly means one longer read and slower course correction.

recommendation.because: You asked for fewer interruptions, but I have no data on how long a weekly read takes you.

questions.why: I made these calls myself because each is easy to undo and I am confident in it; this is your chance to overrule any of them.
questions.label: I decided these without asking. Tick any you want me to revisit.

options.label: Docs changes go live without a yes

questions.label: Which region hosts the service today?

recommendation.because: The last three deploy logs name us-west.
recommendation.risk: A migration may have happened since.

options.label: United States
options.badge: Named in the last three deploy logs

questions.why: Anything you write here goes straight into the release checklist.
questions.label: What worries you about this release?
questions.placeholder: As much detail as you like

questions.label: Write the release headline.
questions.maxLengthReason: The changelog feed cuts headlines at 80 characters.

knownContext: Decided without asking (high confidence, easy to undo): docs changes go live without a yes; release branches are named release/YYYY-MM-DD. DECIDED_REVISIT lists any the respondent reopened.
